response.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT event_status, amount - spent AS left_over FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND spent IS NOT NULL), o AS (SELECT AVG(left_over) AS overall FROM d) SELECT d.event_status, AVG(d.left_over) AS avg_left_over, AVG(d.left_over) - o.overall AS diff_from_overall FROM d CROSS JOIN o WHERE d.event_status IS NOT NULL AND o.overall IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.event_status, o.overall
